verdict_reason: v0.1 측정·평가와 A/B 개별 구현은 검증 가능한 부분이 있으나, A serving tree와 B operations tree가 하나의 Git release로 통합되지 않았고 observability, regression gate, rollback의 fail-open 결함이 남아 있다. 따라서 Build→Deploy→Observe→Alert→Diagnose→Regression Test→Rollback→Evidence closed loop를 재현 가능한 단일 release로 입증하지 못했다.

failed_gates.reason: A deployment implementation is outside the canonical Git tree and real vLLM/A6000 Compose startup, readiness and shutdown were not executed.
Prometheus gateway target is empty and B PromQL depends on metrics/labels not exposed by A. The A service cannot be observed by the submitted B stack.
GPU evaluation can reuse a stale report after rag_eval failure; all selected stages can be skipped and still return exit code 0; release promotion trusts manifest prose and file existence.
Release state changes even when restart is not executed or fails, image_digest may be null, and verification does not require gateway /ready.

The canonical release claims stage=all while linking a CPU report, and multiple README/result/incident statements convert A6000 memory-budget evidence into target-card fit language. Native 24GB validation does not exist.

majors: Alert rate windows and for durations are explicitly PENDING_THRESHOLD_VALIDATION and can miss the two-second load bursts used by this project.
DCGM alert queries do not select the service GPU; the observed host has two A6000 GPUs.
Rollback verify treats missing gateway metrics as A not deployed and never checks /ready.
Release schema permits null image_digest, a seven-character git_sha and mutable shell restart_command.
GPU CI identifies runs-on only as [self-hosted, gpu] and does not assert A6000 hardware/provenance.
INC-002 labels activeAt as firing time despite the rule's for:1m delay.
Result decision text and README use target-card fit wording even though every 2026-08-08c record is A6000 memory-budget-emulation.
minor_remaining_risks: The A shutdown timeout default is PENDING_VALIDATION rather than a measured production drain budget.
Prompt injection succeeds in 2 of 5 injection cases; the gate only prevents further regression.
The 60-case evaluation and synthetic 16-document corpus do not establish production-traffic generalization.

release_recommendation: DO_NOT_RELEASE. Preserve both trees and evidence, integrate A into the canonical repository through an explicit reviewed merge, reconcile the interface contract, close regression/rollback fail-open paths, then execute one real A6000 end-to-end release rehearsal.
next_actions: Create one immutable integration commit containing A and B, with a single service/network/metric contract and Prometheus target.
Add deterministic reproductions for stale-eval, all-skipped, failed-restart and missing-readiness paths, then make all four fail closed.
Run docker compose on one A6000 and retain /ready, /metrics, alert, in-flight drain and digest rollback evidence before re-judging the release.
